title: openai-compat: support Responses variants + seed/determinism flags + metadata passthrough
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add parity with OpenAI Responses API variants by exposing seed/determinism controls and preserving arbitrary user metadata through the Redwood OpenAI compatibility layer. This fixes customer-reported issues where deterministic testing and metadata propagation for audit/tracing were lost when routing through Redwood. Changes: 1) responses_adapter: map OpenAI 'seed' and 'determinism' fields to our runtime options and add validation for incompatible values; 2) streaming: stabilize streaming code path for Responses streaming frames (ensures metadata headers are emitted exactly once and streaming termination respects deterministic seeds); 3) sdk compatibility: TypeScript + Python SDK updates to accept Responses-style payloads and surface metadata passthrough options; 4) tests: add unit + integration tests for seed determinism, metadata roundtrip, and streaming boundary cases; 5) docs: update compat matrix and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged (seed/determinism are opt-in). For downstream routing we add a compatibility shim to avoid changing existing routing policies. CI: added new test matrix for Responses variants on dedicated and hosted runtime. Rollout: feature gated behind env REDWOOD_OPENAI_RESPONSES_COMPAT (off by default) to allow gradual rollout and quick rollback if we observe regressions. Checklist: - implemented mapping and validation for seed/determinism - metadata passthrough preserved end-to-end - streaming termination edge-cases handled - added unit/integration tests - updated docs and changelog References: ENG-5421 (Responses compatibility), ENG-5504 (streaming stability), SUP-1221 (customer-reported metadata loss).

release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses compatibility: opt-in support for Responses API variants including seed/determinism controls and metadata passthrough. Streaming stability improvements for Responses streams. Feature gated behind REDWOOD_OPENAI_RESPONSES_COMPAT.
notes: Feature gated rollout to ensure safety. Monitoring: added two metrics (compat.responses.enabled, compat.responses.seeded_count) and an alert for increased error rate during rollout.
